user_story: As a returning user, I want to log in to the secure area at https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login so that I can access protected content. Acceptance criteria: the form has fields '#username' and '#password' and a submit button 'button[type="submit"]'; logging in with username 'tomsmith' and password 'SuperSecretPassword!' navigates to a URL containing '/secure' and shows the flash banner '.flash.success' with text containing 'You logged into a secure area!'.
